test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 02
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is correct regarding the Agni-3 missile test conducted on February 6, 2026?

options.text: The missile was launched from a fixed silo by the Indian Army's Artillery Regiment.
It is a three-stage liquid-propelled missile with a precision-strike range of 2,000 kilometres.
The test was conducted by the Strategic Forces Command (SFC) from a mobile launcher at Chandipur.
The missile is designed to carry a maximum payload of 500 kilograms and can be extended upto a distance of 5,000 kilometres.

solution: The correct answer is **The test was conducted by the Strategic Forces Command (SFC) from a mobile launcher at Chandipur.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** • **India successfully test-fired the nuclear-capable Agni-3 ballistic missile off the Odisha coast on February 6, 2026.**
